overview_description.description:
Rabbet(https://rabbet.com/) is a real estate software company with two products: Rabbet Development and Rabbet Construction Lending. Our mission is to take the friction out of real estate development execution through structured, connected financial data. We help real estate teams turn fragmented project information into trusted insights that can be shared, understood, and acted on throughout the development lifecycle.

Rabbet Development (https://rabbet.com/developers/product-overview) is real estate development management software for owners, developers, and asset managers. It brings budgets, anticipated costs, draw schedules, and funding sources together across every phase of development, so teams always know where every project stands, answer questions without chasing information, and spot financial changes before they become project problems.

Rabbet Construction Lending (https://rabbet.com/lenders/product-overview) is construction loan management software for banks, credit unions, and private lenders. It brings loan administration, documentation, draw review, and portfolio reporting into one system, so lending policies are applied consistently, portfolio risk is visible as projects evolve, and every funding decision is backed by the evidence and an audit trail required to move money.
